changedPaths.change: Q1. The private closed MODEL_SELECTION grammar now also declares option arity for the options the transport and actor owners compose. claude operands: --output-format --permission-mode --tools --json-schema --append-system-prompt. claude flags: -p --disable-slash-commands --no-session-persistence --include-partial-messages --verbose --safe-mode. codex operands: --sandbox -o. codex flags: --full-auto --skip-git-repo-check. modelSelectionFromArguments skips the operand of a declared value-bearing option as data. A selector-shaped argument directly after an option outside the grammar, or anywhere after `--`, returns model_selection_ambiguous. Exported types, the unknown-reason list, deriveConfiguredActorIdentity, configuredActorIdentityCorresponds and the event-contract profile are unchanged; the grammar is module-private and feeds no digest.

Q4. decideQualificationDispatchEligibility takes peers as the declared peer-slot population, each entry {slotRef, selections}, or null when the plan declares no peer. It compares every admitted occurrence first, so a same-family peer stays ineligible and an unresolved one stays unknown. It then returns unknown(required_peer_missing) when no peer slot is declared or any declared slot has no admitted occurrence.

Q4. admittedPeerSelections keeps admitted occurrences per declared peer slot and returns every declared slot, so a slot with no start keeps an empty list instead of disappearing. The dispatch call site is unchanged. Replay in resolveQualificationAssessments passes the same per-slot shape, one selected J per declared slot, or an empty list if a slot row were absent.

Section 3 Q23. Item 1 states the declared arity, operand-as-data and unknown-role rules. Item 5 makes every declared peer slot required, and its order bullet makes a missing slot unknown(required_peer_missing). Item 6 replaces the rejected first-peer-without-peer-evidence sentence with per-slot collection and states that fresh peer-required plans are refused. Item 7 replays over every declared peer slot. Production limits record the peer-route dependency and the at-most-one-operand assumption for options outside the grammar.
One new test plus added assertions in the existing binding-contract test (event-store admission of the operand case).

nativeHistory gains a labelled per-slot `peers` premise. Each entry is a selection (an admitted start), 'unstarted' (peer call opened, no actor start) or 'absent' (never opened). Two peers give the assessor two criteria with distinct criterionRefs, one shared with each peer. The single-peer history is byte-identical to before. Owner-level, Validator-level and actual actor_process gate cases are added for Q4, and owner and gate cases for Q1.

residuals.fact: Slot-complete refusal makes every fresh author_and_peer_distinct plan non-dispatchable: its first slot has no prior admitted peer start. No existing owner in this cone supplies authenticated configured identity or evidence for a declared peer slot before that slot's own actor start. A production peer route needs a separately selected owner relation outside the six-path grant. Author_distinct dispatch is unaffected.

Declared arity covers only the options the transport and actor owners compose. An option outside the grammar is treated as consuming at most the next argument. A hypothetical unlisted option with two or more fixed operands before a selector-shaped argument is not modelled. No live CLI behavior is claimed.

No new replay test of a complete peer plan through resolveQualificationAssessments. The replay change only reshapes facts that were already slot-complete. Existing Q23 J readback tests cover single-slot plans.

The two-peer fixture gives the assessor two criteria with the same rule/surface groups and distinct criterionRefs, one shared with each peer, because the policy publishes two actor refs. This is a component premise, not a production plan.
